Introduction
This document outlines the equipment 
 inspection I1, which must be performed annually bases as indicated by Y1 
 in the title block.
In ventilation and air condition system chilled water system 
 carries out the function to release in to the cooling water heat absorbed by 
 air conditioning units in to air conditioned rooms and building heat removal 
 function is performed all the year around
Chilled water system is divided in to two section :- section 
 one produces and distributes chilled water to air conditioning units as 
 flows :

Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued, 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety ID category
Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear the safety and healthy

Main supply disconnected switch

Maintenance is carried out with 
 cooperation with electrical department
Tools 
and Equipment
Mechanical tools 
 ( complete set of manual wrench - brushes - etc)
Blanco 1 ton
Tighten hexagonal screw with atorqe 
 wrench
Work to be 
carried out
Empty the low pressure circuit
Connect the oil pump fitted on the compressor sump after a dearator filter
Discharge the connection pipe and when the oil is on the sump connection 
 pump the oil into the sump as long as oil level reaches the half position of 
 the sight glass
Take out the pipe and close the connection
